\paragraph{Appearance and learned visual cues.} Domain randomization varies simulated appearance to improve transfer \citep{Tobin2017Domain,Tremblay2018Training}. Texture--shape cue conflicts reveal that models can rely on visual evidence different from that used by humans \citep{Geirhos2019Texture}. Our intervention targets an operational source of appearance variation: changing a scene's material representation while retaining its geometry. This lets us examine localization and navigation decisions under a concrete transformation encountered when simulation assets are reused.
